# H2-C sequencing / interlock simulation results -- revision 3 (as built)

**Gating result (as-built design ASB incl. all corners, nominal + pessimistic): FAIL**

**BEHAVIOURAL / PRELIMINARY -- not hardware-validated.** ngspice behavioural models with datasheet timing. Generated by `run_h2c_sim.py`. Every ASB* design gates the exit code; R2 is shown for comparison.

Designs: **R2** = schematic before REC (rev 2: U915 only); **ASB** = as built: REC with CSD16301Q2 / 3x1 ohm / DMG1012T Q2,Q3,Q966 / TPS386000 / BAT54C / TLV75518P; **ASB_cb09** = as built, crowbar VGS(th) 0.9 V (min); **ASB_cb155** = as built, crowbar VGS(th) 1.55 V (max); **ASB_q05** = as built, DMG1012T VGS(th) 0.5 V (Q2, Q3, Q966); **ASB_q10** = as built, DMG1012T VGS(th) 1.0 V (Q2, Q3, Q966); **ASB_toff-** = as built, TPS22810 tOFF -50 % (1.65 us); **ASB_toff+** = as built, TPS22810 tOFF +50 % (4.95 us); **ASB_td20** = as built, supervisor detection delay 20 us; **ASB_td50** = as built, supervisor detection delay 50 us; **ASB_td100** = as built, supervisor detection delay 100 us; **ASB_slow** = as built, slow-crowbar corner: Q2 0.5 V, crowbar 1.55 V, supervisor 100 us; **ASB_ovl** = as built, overlap corner: Q2 1.0 V, crowbar 0.9 V, tOFF +50 %; **FIX** = candidate M5 fix (not built): BAT54C clamps replaced by 2 x DMG1012T on IL_Q3G; R976 fed from supervisor VDD OR +1V8_DIG; **FIX_slow** = FIX at the slow corner; **FIX_ovl** = FIX at the overlap corner

Logic modes: **nom** = nominal thresholds; **pess** = every comparator / LVC / enable input inside its undefined band taken as HIGH / ON (LVC with VCC < 1.65 V outputs VCC, flop SET).
